cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 53 since 2014 and has led the House Democratic Caucus as Minority Leader since 2017. Former elementary school teacher and co-owner of a dental practice. Ran for Alabama's 2nd Congressional District in 2024 and lost the runoff.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Daniels was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. We found no sponsored bills, speeches or statements showing what he has done or said on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land protection, immigration and H-1B, police and public order, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His Ballotpedia page lists no sponsored bills, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys for 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements. The Wikipedia page was brief and only partly sourced.
